title: CPS-0002 Human Signal Assertion
description: Prototype CPS-0002 assertion that references a CPS-0001 Continuity Receipt by hash and provides a human-signal attestation. NOT proof of human authenticity — cryptographic validity only.

protocolType.description: CPS-0002 assertion protocol type. Identifies this as a Human Signal Assertion, draft 0.1.

assertionId.description: UUIDv7 assertion identifier. Distinguishes this assertion from all others.

id.description: Opaque attester identifier. Not a human identity — just a label for the signing key.

publicKey.description: Ed25519 public key (32 bytes, hex). Used to verify the assertion signature.

id.description: Subject identifier. SHOULD be the same as the referenced CPS-0001 receipt's subject.id, establishing the binding.

type.description: Optional subject type hint, inherited from the referenced receipt. Values not normative.

receiptHash.description: SHA-256(JCS(referenced CPS-0001 receipt)). The binding between this assertion and the receipt.

receiptId.description: The receiptId of the referenced CPS-0001 receipt. For lookup convenience; the hash is the cryptographic binding.

engineId.description: Evidence engine identifier. The toy attester uses 'TOY-HSA-999' to signal non-production.

confidence.description: Attester's confidence in the human-signal evidence. The toy attester uses 0.0 to signal no real evidence.

payload.description: Opaque evidence payload, interpreted as parsed I-JSON-compatible JSON (unique keys, valid UTF-8, numbers within IEEE-754 double range). NOT part of the 12-field signed payload; bound to it only through payloadDigest. The toy attester uses a label indicating TOY/PROTOTYPE status.

payloadDigest.description: Integrity commitment over evidence.payload: lowercase hex of SHA-256(UTF8(JCS(evidence.payload))), where JCS is RFC 8785 canonical JSON serialization applied to the parsed I-JSON payload. Signed as field #9 of the 12-field canonical assertion payload; verifiers MUST independently recompute it (V2.5) and reject mismatches with INVALID_PAYLOAD_DIGEST. Malformed (non-64-lowercase-hex) values are INVALID_SCHEMA. (Normative since BATCH-0002-3-F8; previously SHA-256(JSON.stringify(payload)).)

issuedAt.description: ISO 8601 — when the assertion was issued. MUST be <= signedAt.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 — after this time, the assertion is no longer fresh. Default: 1 hour after issuedAt.

value.description: Ed25519 signature (64 bytes, hex). Covers the 12-field canonical assertion payload.

signedAt.description: ISO 8601 — when the signature was produced. MUST be parseable.
